question: Characterise recorded phase-current changes following published current-limit changes in new KIT LF traces; no new predictive model, fitting or control-capacity claim.
object: All18 original LF recording sets/16 brand-model combinations,12 brands in Zenodo17866847v1.0.0; do not merge with Dortmund/EPFL devices or inherit their parameters.
evidence: Dataset officialCC-BY4.0 metadata and full-file MD5 checked. Author preprint abstract describes50Hz phase measurements and current-limit changes; full SSRN PDF403 not bypassed. Not exact full-paper reproduction or standards compliance.
time: timestamp_ns physical/logical TIMESTAMP_MICROS(isAdjustedToUTC=false). Decode integer microseconds and use within-trace relative differences; retain original Parquet row order, never sort/interpolate. No physical microsecond precision or timezone/network timestamp claim.
candidate: Every adjacent change in the raw setpoint_a becomes an event; first row is not a change. Report every candidate and all3 phases, not just successful responses.

admission.command: Both previous and new commands>=6A and absolute change>=2A. These are prespecified study operating filters, not claims of current IEC compliance.
admission.pre: Complete[-5s,0) window with constant previous command, first/last observations within50ms of its edges.
admission.post: Complete[0,15s) window with constant new command, first/last observations within50ms of edges; this is retrospective complete-held-command conditioning, not an availability prediction.
admission.continuity: Strictly increasing finite timestamps, all adjacent gaps within entire[-5,15) window<=50ms; otherwise exclude window, keep status. All finite phase current and command, no target/error clipping.
admission.phase: For each L1/L2/L3 independently require PRE-window observed median>=1A. Label preceding measured-load condition, not a confirmed connection/charging state. Report excluded inactive/start/stop cases separately; do not infer phase activity from future maximum.
admission.intent: No output/response-residual based deletion; slow, limited, overshooting or unreached eligible responses remain.

features.baseline: PRE observed phase-current median I0, input change du=u_new-u_old. Normalised progress=sign(du)*(I(t)-I0)/abs(du), not normalised by future observed final response.
features.crossings: First original sample with progress>=0.1 or>=0.9 and all subsequent original samples remaining above that threshold for at least100000us; search crossing starts in[0,10s], confirmation can extend to10.1s. Return original sample interval bounds, no interpolated crossing or asserted sub-sample precision.
features.censoring: No qualifying crossing means not observed within10s at requested command-step magnitude; return null/censored, never0 or artificial10s delay. It may reflect limited draw, timing, physical dynamics or other unknowns; not proof of a particular fault or infinite latency.
features.transition_duration: t90_sample-t10_sample only when both observed; not a count of90percent accurate predictions.
features.steady: Observed current median in[10,15s) minus NEW command, unitsA; report signed/absolute errors without using it to select phases/events.
features.ideal_comparison: Instantaneous exact tracking is an interpretive ideal only. No fit/no claimed error reduction versus earlier baselines; no90percent model-accuracy conversion.

aggregation: all candidates/phase admissions and exclusion flags
steady error/bias and worst event retained
event counts distinct from recording sets, vehicles and correlated phase observations
reproducibility: Before features bind all candidate windows and statuses with hashes; one calculation plus deterministic replay; independently reconstruct counts/window semantics and scalar threshold/statistics; preserve source order/limits.
